notes: FRAME: raw fpE registration (tools/reg.json), the sheet the task names. fpE content is rotated ~0.42 deg counter-clockwise against the E-aligned global frame (E walls 0.28-0.45 deg, parking lines 0.41-0.47 deg); near E this is <= 0.07 m. Not corrected, so the site matches E1/M1 measured on fpE. To get the E-aligned frame: rotate +0.42 deg (clockwise on the drawing) about (9.0, 11.75).

IMPORTANT, M2 vs E between sheets: on fpD/fpC the whole site underlay (trees, walls, parking row, fill rings) AND building M2 sit ~0.6-0.75 m further north (dz -0.57..-0.75, dx -0.07) relative to E than on fpE (NCC of fpE vs fpD per region; tree circles e.g. (-19.10,6.80) fpE vs (-19.18,6.06) fpD). The development plan p0_aerial (registered on the plot line) agrees with fpE for E, M2 and the plot. So M2.json/M3.json/M4.json (fpD/fpC/fpB) sit ~0.7 m north of this site and of M1.json; M1_aligned.json uses fpE->fpD = rot +0.504 deg about (0,0) then (+0.041,-0.695). If the M2 upper floors are kept in their fpD position, apply that same transform to the M2-zone features of this file (M2 gardens, fill rings, x~-15.2 / x~-0.1 walls, entrance path/steps, south drive west branch); E-zone features must stay.

Plot ("plot") = the red "גבול מגרש" line as drawn on fpE (raw registration): sides fitted to the red trace (rms 0.02-0.04 m), NW fillet R 7.64 tangent to the W and N lines, north side 842-70-71 from the survey fit (within 0.02-0.07 m of the printed line under the hand-drawn red, which wobbles +-0.1). Area 1367 m2 vs printed 1381 ("1.381 ד."): the drawn lot is ~0.4 m narrower E-W than the survey dimensions because fpE's x scale in tools/reg.json is ~0.7-1 % too large (E1 notes: E measures 17.875 for 18.00; stall groups 9.11-9.13 for "4X2.3=9.2"; "9.32" from E to the east line measures 9.26). "plot_survey" = survey dimensions (71-72 24.54, 72-73 8.45, 73-77 4.28, 77-76 16.41, 76-81 19.40, 81-843 24.69, NW fillet R 7.50, 842-70 14.52, arc 70-71 R 342.50 / 27.35) closure-adjusted and rigidly fitted to the red line (area 1379 m2); it lies 0.18-0.35 m outside the drawn line on the E, W and NW sides, so do not mix it with the fpE-measured features.
North 19.4 deg clockwise from -z (arrows on fpC/fpD vs E walls; survey grid north gives ~19.2 after the fpE tilt). Unit vector given in the E-aligned frame.

Building lines (one closed polyline = buildable envelope): N 2.00 ("200" x2), NW corner = the DRAWN straight chamfer labelled ק. בניין (parallel to M2's central wing, u = -5.44 in the M2R frame; ends at (-17.06,-2.17) on the N line and (-19.75,2.08) on the W line), W 2.00 ("200" x2), S 76-81 3.00 ("300" x2), S 77-76 4.01 ("401") joined to the S 76-81 line by a 1 m jog at x 2.40 (drawn lines stop at x~2.2 / ~2.5; the jog itself is not drawn), notch side 73-77 4.00 ("400", dashed line labelled ק. בניין at x~14.92), E 71-72 3.00 ("300", dash-dot line at x~24.15), notch side 72-73 4.00 ("400" at x~22.0, line at z~16.0 labelled ק. בניין). Straight offsets are taken from the written dimensions. The drawn N line is horizontal at z ~ -2.90 from x~-12 to 18.4: over E it is 1.97-2.02 m from the plot line, but on the M2 side the plot line slopes 2.4 deg, so the drawn line is only 1.89 m from it at the "200" dimension (x -4.4) and ~1.55 m at x -11; the model keeps the written 2.00 (up to 0.45 m south of the drawn line at x -11). The NE junction (x 24.13, z -2.72) is constructed (no drawn line between x 18.6 and the east line). A second dashed line at x~19.4 (z -2..11) is unexplained.

Levels: the east aisle and E's 7 stalls are at the B10 level (grading lines 243.75-244.20 on fpE and on the development plan), ~2.2 m below E's yards (246.15-246.40) and ~3 m below the M2 drive (246.9-248.5). Walls x~18.8/18.9 and x~22.7 are therefore 2-3 m retaining walls; safety railings on them are ASSUMED (not drawn). Stall levels are interpolated from the grading lines.

Parking = 15 open stalls 2.30 x 4.25 (table: lot 2123 = 15): M2 has ONE row of 8 along z 16.9-21.3 drawn as two groups "4X2.3=9.2" separated by a 1.00 m tree pit (not two rows); E has a column of 7 (4 + 3, 1.00 m tree pit) at x 19.6-23.96 facing the east aisle. Stall corners are raw fpE line fits (<= 1 cm rms).

The M2 row (8 stalls) opens onto an aisle that is 3.25 m on this lot ("325") + 3.26 m on lot 2122 ("3.26"). West of the stalls the drive's north edge is the drawn kerb 0.22869 x + 0.97350 z = 21.222 (fpE, parallel to plot side 76-81, also on the development plan; R 1.0 fillet at stall 1\M2, kerb return onto the plot line at (-16.97,25.13)), so the sidewalk in front of the M2 fill rings is ~1.4 m wide and the drive ~6.6 m. The drive's south edge on lot 2122 (plot line + 3.26) and its mouth on B21 are approximate (development plan, 1:250).

Double wall south of E's garden: south line top steps 248.20 / 247.90 / 247.60 ("דירוג", ⊕ on the wall) at ticks x=4.3/10.8/16.85, last step not written (247.30 assumed); north line top 246.40 / 246.10. The text "גבול מגרש" written on it at x~9 is not the plot line (red line is at z~24.4).

Existing levels: survey 1996 bracketed values along the north bank and the west bank; the old ground falls ~6.5 % towards the NE (plane h = 246.51 - 0.052 x + 0.038 z, out/read_site.md). Grading levels are written on dashed lines; positions given are the label positions (+-0.5 m along the line). Survey values ("existing", "contour") sit at the centre of their text on p0_survey (registered with work/SITE/xreg.json, +-0.3 m); the 246.50 / 247.00 / 246.00 contour points lie on their contour lines.
Fill rings (M2, hatched) are also in M1.json as kind "low" walls with h 2.90: they are repeated here with "in_M1": true - build them once.

Gardens: E apt-1 21 m2 matches the NW yard incl. the recess (20.8 m2 at wall lines); E apt-2 labelled 92 m2 ~ NE/E yard + east half of the south garden (~98 m2); the west half of the south garden has no label. E's ground-floor outline used for the garden edges is read from fpE; the south-west / south-east garden edges stop at the laundry-screen lines (z 7.86 / 7.72) of E1.json's מעבה niches. DUPLICATES: E1.json and M1.json "outdoor" carry their own garden / yard / entrance-path polygons over the same ground (E1's use E1's wall lines, e.g. ממ"ד face 11.62); render ground surfaces from ONE source (this file or the floor files), not both.
